description: Check for pending tasks assigned to you (or a specific agent) or tasks you assigned to others

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

assignee.description: Check tasks for a specific agent by name (only for incoming direction)

direction.description: incoming (assigned to me) or outgoing (I assigned)

name: check_tasks
